name: seedspec
description: Protocol, structural runtime, and CLI for portable agent-ready specifications

scripts.release:pack: npm pack --workspace @seedspec/protocol --dry-run && npm pack --workspace @seedspec/runtime --dry-run && npm pack --workspace @seedspec/cli --dry-run
scripts.lint: eslint packages/protocol/src packages/runtime/src packages/runtime/test packages/cli/bin packages/cli/test scripts eslint.config.js
scripts.validate:fixtures: node ./packages/cli/bin/seedspec.js validate ./conformance/v0.4/fixtures/minimum && node ./packages/cli/bin/seedspec.js validate ./conformance/v0.4/fixtures/merged-sections && node ./packages/cli/bin/seedspec.js validate ./examples/daily-pipeline/package
scripts.check: npm run release:verify && npm run check:names && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test --workspace @seedspec/cli && npm run validate:fixtures && npm run conformance && npm run bakeoff && npm run test:harness
